market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $70 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL active month settlement currently ~$98. 52-week low was $54.98 (so $70 was breached at some point in past year). Whether market was created before or after that low determines if already Yes. Going forward from $98, hitting $70 in 2 months requires ~28% drop — possible only with major demand shock or OPEC supply surge. Estimate ~20-30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Market creation date unknown; geopolitical de-escalation timing.
